category_title: Low-achieving students who monitor collective synthesis and reference usage to improve community knowledge
scenario_title: Surface-level interpretation of quantitative data in the KCA tool
minimal_context: The student is using the Knowledge Connections Analyzer tool in the classroom to assess the community's synthesis and collaboration.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open the Knowledge Connections Analyzer tool and review the data to reflect on our community's synthesis and collaboration.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I'm looking at the numbers. The number of reference notes is 34 and the number of notes that are being used as references is 56. We have written more than 150 notes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am wondering whether we have really read the notes carefully and applied them to date.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else do you see in the tool?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Just these numbers. These data tell us that the extent of synthesis and collaboration is not higher than our expectation. I don't see what else to look at besides the counts it generated.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please open the Knowledge Connections Analyzer tool and review the data to reflect on our community's synthesis and collaboration.

STUDENT: Okay, I'm looking at the numbers. The number of reference notes is 34 and the number of notes that are being used as references is 56. We have written more than 150 notes.

TUTOR: What does that tell you?

STUDENT: I am wondering whether we have really read the notes carefully and applied them to date.

TUTOR: What else do you see in the tool?

STUDENT: Just these numbers. These data tell us that the extent of synthesis and collaboration is not higher than our expectation. I don't see what else to look at besides the counts it generated.

task.content: Using the Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool to reflect on community synthesis and collaboration.
task.learning_goal: To recognize the cognitive opportunities afforded by the qualitative information provided and assess community synthesis.

context.environment: Classroom setting during the reflective assessment phase
context.materials: Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool, KCA prompt sheets, reflective journal, Knowledge Forum platform
context.social_setting: Individual reflection and small group work
context.time_context: Immediately after the introduction of the KCA tool

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Initial use of the KCA tool immediately after its introduction
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Noticed only the quantitative data generated by the KCA; they did not recognize the cognitive opportunities afforded by the qualitative information provided.

behavior_patterns.condition: When analyzing the Knowledge Forum database for synthesis
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Identifies specific counts of reference notes (34) and notes being used as references (56) out of total notes written (more than 150) to evaluate if the extent of synthesis and collaboration meets expectations.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Wondering whether we have really read the notes carefully and applied them to date
